relations.subject: Bruno Dagens
relations.evidence: Dagens began to study archaeology in his early years in Afghanistan, influenced by Daniel Schlumberger.

relations.subject: Bruno Dagens
relations.evidence: He joined the École française d'Extrême-Orient (EFEO) in 1969, and remained in office for three years in Cambodia

relations.subject: Bruno Dagens
relations.evidence: From 1972 to 1977, he was a lecturer at the Université catholique de Louvain

relations.subject: Bruno Dagens
relations.evidence: In October 1977, he was appointed director of the Indology section at the French Institute of Pondicherry.

relations.subject: Bruno Dagens
relations.role: Professor of Ancient History and Archaeology of South and Southeast Asia
relations.evidence: In 1986, he became Professor of Ancient History and Archaeology of South and Southeast Asia at the University of Paris III and has remained in that position since.
